title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #4

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many verses does Surah Al-Falaq have? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 6
   C. 4
   D. 5

2. What is a single verse of the Qur'an called? (1 mark)
   A. A rak'ah
   B. A surah
   C. An ayah
   D. A juz

3. Why does Al-Falaq teach us to seek refuge from envy? (1 mark)
   A. Envy is a game
   B. Envy is a harmful feeling and only Allah can protect us
   C. Envy makes people rich
   D. Envy brings prayer

4. The two surahs of seeking refuge are (1 mark)
   A. Al-Falaq and An-Naas
   B. Al-Kafirun and Al-Fatiha
   C. Al-Fatiha and Al-Ikhlas
   D. Al-Masad and An-Nasr

5. Which is NOT a trait of the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Generosity
   B. Truthfulness
   C. Patience
   D. Cheating in trade

6. What is the meaning of "adab of eating"? (1 mark)
   A. A fast
   B. A prayer
   C. A type of food
   D. The etiquette or good manners of eating

7. Which is an example of wasting food? (1 mark)
   A. Finishing your food
   B. Throwing away half a plate you took
   C. Taking a small portion
   D. Sharing leftovers with a neighbour

8. What does "Bismillah" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Allah is the Greatest
   B. Glory be to Allah
   C. All praise is for Allah
   D. In the name of Allah

9. According to the syllabus hadith, brushing teeth is a means of (1 mark)
   A. Making teeth white only
   B. Avoiding prayer
   C. Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah
   D. Gaining money

10. Which skill helps keep a person safe near water? (1 mark)
   A. Archery
   B. Chess
   C. Swimming
   D. Singing

11. Which value is learned from team games? (1 mark)
   A. Selfishness
   B. Cheating
   C. Pride
   D. Teamwork

12. What should you do when the adhan is called during a game? (1 mark)
   A. Continue the game
   B. Ask for extra time
   C. Turn off the radio
   D. Stop, make wudhu and pray

13. The greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is a prayer for (1 mark)
   A. Money
   B. Peace
   C. Rain
   D. Food

14. What should we do to use Allah's names in dua? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Call on Him with the name that matches our need
   C. Stay silent
   D. Call on other beings

15. Which dua matches the name As-Salam? (1 mark)
   A. Grant us peace in our home and country
   B. Give me many toys
   C. Let me win
   D. Make me famous

16. Which of these is NOT an angel duty? (1 mark)
   A. Recording deeds
   B. Making rain by their own power
   C. Bringing revelation by Allah's order
   D. Taking souls by permission

17. Which duty belongs to Jibril? (1 mark)
   A. Blowing the Trumpet
   B. Taking souls
   C. Bringing revelation
   D. Recording deeds

18. Why must we clean najasaat before prayer? (1 mark)
   A. It saves water
   B. It is a game
   C. It is only for adults
   D. Purity is a condition for valid prayer

19. Which water cannot be used to purify? (1 mark)
   A. Well water
   B. Clean rain water
   C. Water changed in colour, smell or taste by najasa
   D. Tap water

20. Which health benefit does wudhu give? (1 mark)
   A. It removes germs from exposed body parts
   B. It makes us thirsty
   C. It stops hunger
   D. It causes sleep

21. Which of these can help find prayer times? (1 mark)
   A. Guessing from the weather only
   B. Asking a stranger to guess
   C. A mosque timetable or the adhan
   D. Counting stars only

22. To which sides do we turn for taslim? (1 mark)
   A. Up
   B. Only forward
   C. Right, then left
   D. Backwards

23. What is taslim? (1 mark)
   A. The ending greeting of the prayer
   B. The beginning of prayer
   C. Dua
   D. Bowing

24. Which surah is recited in every rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Kafirun
   D. Al-Fatiha

25. Which of these is a Sunnah act, not a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. Raising hands with the first takbir
   B. Sujud
   C. Fatiha
   D. Ruku

26. Why do animals give us benefit? (1 mark)
   A. They give us food, milk, work and transport
   B. They only eat
   C. They cannot help
   D. They are useless

27. Which is a good habit for keeping the environment safe for animals? (1 mark)
   A. Put rubbish in bins
   B. Throw plastic in rivers
   C. Leave litter
   D. Burn plastic

28. The Prophet said those who show mercy will be shown mercy by (1 mark)
   A. The Most Merciful
   B. A friend
   C. The government
   D. The teacher

29. What is a benefit of the Islamic dress code? (1 mark)
   A. Waste
   B. Dignity and protection
   C. Loss of respect
   D. More harm

30. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Learning
   B. Hurting others with messages or online posts
   C. Reading news
   D. Praying

31. What did the Prophet say about speech? (1 mark)
   A. Say what is good or keep silent
   B. Speak loudly
   C. Say whatever
   D. Say everything

32. Which is a good way to help someone who cannot work? (1 mark)
   A. Insult them
   B. Avoid them
   C. Give zakah and sadaqah
   D. Ignore them

33. Why do we say the dua for leaving home? (1 mark)
   A. To be fashionable
   B. To pass time
   C. To be loud
   D. To seek Allah's protection

34. Which name of Allah reminds us He hears our dua? (1 mark)
   A. As-Salam
   B. Al-Malik
   C. As-Sami'
   D. Ar-Rahman

35. Which shows disobedience? (1 mark)
   A. Greeting parents
   B. Speaking softly
   C. Helping with dishes
   D. Slamming doors and refusing to help

36. Who is a "binamu"? (1 mark)
   A. Aunt
   B. Cousin
   C. Uncle
   D. Grandfather

37. What should you do if a relative does not visit you? (1 mark)
   A. Never talk to them
   B. Still visit them kindly
   C. Ignore their events
   D. Insult them

38. In which city was Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) born? (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Makkah
   C. Taif
   D. Cairo

39. Which companion stayed with the Prophet in the cave of Thawr? (1 mark)
   A. Zayd
   B. Ali
   C. Bilal
   D. Abu Bakr

40. What does the Qur'an (9:40) mention about the Prophet and Abu Bakr? (1 mark)
   A. They were together in the cave
   B. They were at Taif
   C. They were in Habasha
   D. They were traders

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Name the five daily prayers in order and give the rak'ahs of any two. (3 marks)

42. Write the six pillars of Iman and put a mark next to the one studied in this lesson. (4 marks)

43. Write the names of prophets in the family chain from Ibrahim to Yusuf. (3 marks)

44. What is an attribute of Allah? Give one example. (2 marks)

45. Explain what the Prophet taught about cutting and selling firewood. (3 marks)

46. Design a short role-play showing the etiquette of eating, listing at least five actions. (5 marks)

47. Why is betting in a game not allowed? (3 marks)

48. Match each surah with one lesson: Al-Fatiha, Al-Kafirun, An-Nasr and Al-Ikhlas. (4 marks)

49. Why is it important for parents to fulfil their obligations? (3 marks)

50. Why is it wrong to pray on time but shout at your family? (3 marks)

51. Suggest three ways to keep in touch with relatives who live far away. (3 marks)

52. State three times when the siwak or toothbrush is recommended. (3 marks)

53. Describe how a Grade 4 child can practise honesty, generosity, patience and obedience. (4 marks)

54. Explain why Muslims should not waste food and give two ways of avoiding waste. (4 marks)

55. State two creatures of Allah in your environment. (2 marks)

56. State two reasons why we wear clothes. (2 marks)

57. Explain the hadith "The upper hand is better than the lower hand". (3 marks)

58. Explain what "Al-Fatiha" means and why it has that name. (3 marks)

59. How should a Muslim treat dogs even though their saliva is heavy najasa? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 5
   Al-Falaq has five verses.

2. C — An ayah
   Ayah (plural ayat) means verse; a chapter is a surah.

3. B — Envy is a harmful feeling and only Allah can protect us
   The fifth verse asks protection from the envier when he envies.

4. A — Al-Falaq and An-Naas
   Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge".

5. D — Cheating in trade
   He never cheated on weights or measures.

6. D — The etiquette or good manners of eating
   Adab means manners.

7. B — Throwing away half a plate you took
   Taking more than you can eat causes waste.

8. D — In the name of Allah
   Bismillah means "In the name of Allah".

9. C — Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah
   The hadith says it purifies the mouth and pleases Allah.

10. C — Swimming
   Swimming can save lives.

11. D — Teamwork
   Working together builds teamwork.

12. D — Stop, make wudhu and pray
   Prayer must not be delayed by play.

13. B — Peace
   It means "peace be upon you".

14. B — Call on Him with the name that matches our need
   Allah told us to call on Him by His names.

15. A — Grant us peace in our home and country
   As-Salam is the Source of Peace.

16. B — Making rain by their own power
   Angels act only by Allah's command.

17. C — Bringing revelation
   He delivered the Qur'an.

18. D — Purity is a condition for valid prayer
   Prayer is not valid with najasa on the body, clothes or place.

19. C — Water changed in colour, smell or taste by najasa
   Its purity has been lost.

20. A — It removes germs from exposed body parts
   Washing keeps us clean.

21. C — A mosque timetable or the adhan
   These are reliable.

22. C — Right, then left
   We greet to the right and left.

23. A — The ending greeting of the prayer
   As-salamu alaykum wa rahmatullah.

24. D — Al-Fatiha
   It is a pillar.

25. A — Raising hands with the first takbir
   Sunnah acts add reward.

26. A — They give us food, milk, work and transport
   Animals serve people.

27. A — Put rubbish in bins
   Animals may eat plastic.

28. A — The Most Merciful
   Recorded by Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi.

29. B — Dignity and protection
   Modest dress protects a person.

30. B — Hurting others with messages or online posts
   Bullying done online.

31. A — Say what is good or keep silent
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

32. C — Give zakah and sadaqah
   Islam encourages charity.

33. D — To seek Allah's protection
   We ask for protection.

34. C — As-Sami'
   As-Sami' is the All-Hearing.

35. D — Slamming doors and refusing to help
   Rudeness is wrong.

36. B — Cousin
   Binamu means cousin.

37. B — Still visit them kindly
   Keep ties even if they do not.

38. B — Makkah
   He was born in Makkah.

39. D — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr was his companion.

40. A — They were together in the cave
   The Qur'an mentions the two in the cave.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fajr (2), Dhuhr (4), Asr (4), Maghrib (3), Isha (4). Any two with correct rak'ahs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for names in order and 2 marks for two rak'ahs.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Belief in Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and destiny. Angels are the one studied.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for every two pillars named, 1 mark for identifying angels.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ibrahim, 1 for Ishaq and Yaqub, 1 for Yusuf in the right order.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: A quality that describes Allah, for example Ar-Rahman, the Most Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a correct example.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Honest work, even hard work like cutting and selling firewood, is better than asking people who may give or refuse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest work, 1 mark for firewood, 1 mark for better than begging.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands; sit; say Bismillah; eat with right hand; eat from in front; do not criticise; say Alhamdulillah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct action, up to 5.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Gambling is forbidden in Islam because it takes people's wealth unfairly and can cause harm and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forbidden, 1 mark for unfairness, 1 mark for harm.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha: praise Allah and ask for guidance; Al-Kafirun: stay firm in faith; An-Nasr: thank Allah when you succeed; Al-Ikhlas: Allah is One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Children grow safe and well-behaved, the family and community are strong, and parents earn Allah's reward.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Islam teaches that faith includes good manners. The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals, so prayer and character go together.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for faith including manners, 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the conclusion.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Call, send messages, send gifts, visit in holidays, attend family events.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before wudhu and prayer, on waking up, when the mouth smells, before sleeping.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct time.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: Honesty: return lost items; generosity: share lunch; patience: wait calmly for a turn; obedience: come when parents call.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each virtue with a suitable action.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah does not love the wasteful. Take only what you can finish, and share leftovers while fresh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reason, 1 mark for Qur'an 7:31 or Allah's dislike, 2 marks for two ways.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two, for example a cow and a bird.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: To cover the body, to protect us from weather, and to look neat and dignified.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: The giving hand is better than the receiving hand. A Muslim should try to work and give rather than depend on others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for giver better, 1 mark for work, 1 mark for the lesson.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha means The Opening. It is the first surah of the Qur'an and it opens every prayer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for first surah, 1 mark for opening the prayer.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kindly, without cruelty, giving them food and water, and only being careful to avoid their saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for not cruel, 1 mark for careful with saliva.
